text:
incident-bot: PAGE jamie (severity P2) — sudden KV/prefix cache eviction spike in us-west-2, prefix hit rate dropped ~78% for a small set of high-cardinality tenants. Telemetry: prefix_miss_rate up, paging latency increased. Dashboard: https://ops.redwood.internal/d/kv-cache/us-west-2

jamie (oncall): got it, looking. any obvious deploys?

dave (sre): no infra deploys in the last hour. paging queues spiked, memory pressure on cache nodes ~85%. suspects prefetch storm + a hot-tenant.

priya (eng): adding: DB-backed prefetchers report lots of failed prefetches -> eviction churn. we should temporarily disable prefetch and bypass prefix caching for affected tenant prefixes for correctness.

jamie (oncall): agree. plan: 1) disable prefetch 2) apply temporary tenant-level rate cap 3) prefix-level bypass for correctness 4) monitor hit-rate and latency 5) handoff if needed.

emma (support): heads-up: which tenants impacted? we need to notify a couple of customers (low risk but possible latency increases).

priya (eng): affected tenants: tenant-123, tenant-omega (small subset). prefices: cust:tenant-123:* and cust:tenant-omega:hotkeys.

jamie (oncall): executing mitigations now.

jamie (oncall): /admin prefetch disable --region us-west-2 --reason "eviction spike"

incident-bot: prefetch disable submitted by jamie — job id 87921.

jamie (oncall): applying tenant rate caps for tenant-123 and tenant-omega to 30rps

jamie (oncall): CLI:
```
./admin quota set --tenant tenant-123 --rate 30rps --region us-west-2
./admin quota set --tenant tenant-omega --rate 30rps --region us-west-2
```

priya (eng): setting prefix bypass for correctness (will route reads around prefix cache for those prefixes). This will increase origin load but avoids stale/incorrect responses.

priya (eng): curl -XPOST https://control-plane.internal/kv/cache-bypass 
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2","prefixes":["cust:tenant-123:*","cust:tenant-omega:hotkeys"],"duration":"30m","reason":"correctness during eviction spike"}'

incident-bot: cache-bypass rule applied (rule id cb-3405).

dave (sre): monitoring: backend CPU + origin QPS up ~22% for those prefixes, but overall tail latency dropping. prefix hit-rate for affected prefixes is still low but requests are correct now.

emma (support): drafting customer note: "We observed increased latency for a small number of requests and applied temporary mitigations. No data loss or incorrect results; some requests routed to origin which may be slower."

jamie (oncall): thumbs up. tagging support channels and CS. @emma please post to customers for tenant-123 and tenant-omega.

emma (support): will do in 15m.

priya (eng): telemetry: eviction rate trending down after prefetch disable. I recommend keeping prefix-bypass on for 30m and then reassess.

jamie (oncall): agreed. set a check at +25m to reevaluate. if stable, revert bypass and slowly raise tenant caps.

dave (sre): one more pragmatic mitigation: enable soft-ttl on the long-tail prefixes to reduce churn. will push a conservative change (TTL 5m) for cust:tenant-omega:hotkeys only.

priya (eng): okay to proceed — that should give cache breathing room.

jamie (oncall): deploying soft-ttl change now:
```
./admin cache update-ttl --prefix "cust:tenant-omega:hotkeys" --ttl 300 --region us-west-2
```

incident-bot: change applied, job id 87923.

dave (sre): monitoring: miss-rate down from 78% -> 34% over 12 minutes, origin QPS steady. latency p95 improved from 420ms -> 210ms for affected prefixes.

jamie (oncall): good. I'm going offline in ~40m. handoff to dave at 03:30 UTC. dave, you'll own until I return.

dave (sre): taking handoff. I'll keep prefix bypass in place and watch origin QPS/cost. If origin cost goes above threshold, we'll scale origin or carveout tenant.

emma (support): customer comms sent to tenant-123 + tenant-omega. CS will monitor replies.

priya (eng): reminder: once bypass is removed, we should run a short smoke eval on correctness and run a small canary for prefetch re-enable.

jamie (oncall): noted. summary for post-incident doc: root cause probable prefetch storm causing eviction churn on us-west-2 nodes -> correctness risk for prefix cache. mitigations: prefetch disabled, tenant caps applied, prefix-level cache bypass for correctness, soft-ttl for high-churn prefix. status: stabilization in progress, hit-rate trending back, no data correctness incidents reported.

dave (sre): status update @ 30m: eviction rate 9% of previous peak, hit-rate ~82% for affected prefixes, leaving bypass for another 10m then removing if stable.

incident-bot: NOTE: please file follow-up ticket for review of prefetch heuristics and tenant isolation (ops-2345).

jamie (oncall): thanks team. I'll file a short postmortem doc in incidents/ later. :white_check_mark:
